reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (agent), blind look at every hole in both modes

bro-hof-stadium-h06.reason: Lätt 3D draws a broad pond filling the 22–39 m carry in front of the tee, while the photo shows only a narrow creek with a small widening there, so the water looks much too big in the phone map.
bro-hof-stadium-h06.resolution: The water in the 22-39 m carry is two mapped ponds (lm-water-659_64-25 and -27, 461 and 797 m2), not only the creek: on the 2025 photo at full scale (looked at on 27 November for the reed decisions) both outlines lie on the water's edge, the larger about 15 m across, which is the 17 m carry band Lätt 3D draws. At the sheet's scale the photo strip shows them as a dark widening of the creek.

bro-hof-stadium-h07.reason: Detaljerad 3D ovanifrån shows a dark grey rectangle lying in the lake beside the footbridge at the north end of the pond; neither Lätt 3D nor the photo shows anything there.
bro-hof-stadium-h07.fault: Detaljerad 3D from above: a flat grey slab with straight edges lies in the north-west corner of the pond on Stadium 7 (lm-water-659_64-28) beside the footbridge, seen also from Castle 4. With ?waterreach=0 it is gone, so the pond's reach carve makes it, as it makes the two slabs by Stadium 14-15 (walkthrough); the reeds do not. Next step: read the bed field at the slab (the carve's refined and broad depths) with the prepared water off.

bro-hof-stadium-h09.reason: Lätt 3D has a patch of white speckled noise on the big lake left of the fairway near the 177 m mark, which reads as a broken texture rather than water.
bro-hof-stadium-h09.fault: Lätt 3D: the white speckles are the map's sun glitter on the ripples (apps/golf/src/map/map-gl.mjs) in a view across the water toward the sun; at the hole view's zoom they read as static, and every blind look has doubted them (Castle 17, Stadium 9 and 15). Tone the glitter down at hole-view zooms in map-gl.mjs.

bro-hof-stadium-h15.reason: Lätt 3D has a wide patch of white speckled noise covering the water at the bottom of the map around the tee, which reads as a broken texture rather than water.

bro-hof-stadium-h18.reason: Detaljerad 3D från tee has a large, flat dark-grey slab filling the left foreground right beside the tee box, much wider than any path in the photo at the tees.
bro-hof-stadium-h18.resolution: The flat grey area is the asphalt cart path (the pack's cartpath, 2.6 m wide), 4.5 m from the yellow and blue tee marks the view stands at: from eye height that close, a 2.6 m path fills the left foreground with its hard mapped edge. Lätt 3D and the photo show the same path passing the tee.

bro-hof-castle-h04.reason: Detaljerad 3D ovanifrån shows a grey rectangle lying in the pond right of the green, next to the diagonal footbridge, which the photo does not show.

open.canonical-control-pending: No independent horizontal or RH 2000 ground control has been measured at Bro Hof; the frame is the 1 m national terrain and the 0.16 m orthophoto, which agree with each other.
open.canonical-frame: The ground origin is fixed in software and has not been approved against independent control, as at every other ground.
open.release-review: The fourteen-gate release review (phone timings, offline and rollback rehearsal) is not run; by the owner's decision of 27 November 2026 the course is released on this blind visual review of every hole in both modes instead.
open.surface-intake-pending: All 36 holes were traced on the 2025 orthophoto, looked at hole by hole and blind by the ring reviewer; by the owner's decision of 27 November 2026 no person reviews the outlines before release.
